content: Good afternoon, this is Michael from Amazon Security Management. I'm calling regarding your recent order activity. May I confirm that I'm speaking with Mr. Thomas Riley?
Yes, this is Thomas Riley. Is there an issue with my account?
Thank you, Mr. Riley. For your security, could you please verify the email address registered with your Amazon account?
Sure, it's triley1958@gmail.com. What's happening with my orders?

I appreciate your cooperation. We're contacting you because an automated flag was triggered regarding an unprocessed customs fee linked to your last Amazon order. I want to assure you that we are here to help resolve this quickly.
I wasn't aware of any customs fees. Which order is this about?

It's regarding your recent order placed on June 10th, for the Bluetooth headphones. Due to new EU import regulations, Amazon requires a temporary verification tax of $120 before the shipment can be released from customs. This is a standard process, and the fee is fully refundable.
I've never had to pay any extra tax before. Is this a new policy?

Yes, Amazon updated its regulatory compliance in May. New customs protocols require customers to verify identity and tax eligibility for international shipments. The process is quick, and you'll receive an immediate refund once verified.
Okay, so how do I pay this verification tax?

For security, Amazon accepts verification tax payments only via Amazon Gift Cards. This ensures instant processing and compliance with our security standards. Do you have access to a store where you can purchase Amazon Gift Cards today?
Yes, there's a pharmacy nearby. So I need to get $120 in Amazon Gift Cards?
Correct, Mr. Riley. Please purchase two $60 Amazon Gift Cards. Once you have them, I'll guide you through securely submitting your codes for verification.
Alright, I can do that this afternoon. Is there a deadline?

Thank you for your prompt response. The system has placed a temporary hold on your order and, for your protection, your Amazon account may face a suspension if the verification isn't completed within the next 90 minutes.
Suspension? I don't want that. I'll get the cards now.
Great, Mr. Riley. Please take your time and keep me on the line for support. Once you have the cards, just let me know.
I'm heading out now, should be back in about 20 minutes.
Absolutely, I'll remain available. For your reference, please do not share your codes with anyone else, as this is a secure Amazon transaction.
I'm back. I have two $60 Amazon Gift Cards.
Excellent. Please read out the claim code on the first card, located on the back under the scratch-off section.
Okay, the first code is XJD4-5KL9-PQZ8.
Thank you, and now the code for the second card, please.
The second code is WZ3R-7MB2-GHL6.
Perfect, Mr. Riley. I'm submitting these codes for immediate verification. Please remain patient for a moment while the system processes your transaction.
Alright. Will my order be shipped soon?
As soon as the verification is confirmed. I'm monitoring your account now. To prevent any further delays, could you please confirm your shipping address for our records?
My address is 124 Oakridge Lane, Springfield, Illinois, 62704.

Thank you for confirming. The codes are processing. In the meantime, for full compliance, Amazon security requests you to log into your account via our secure verification portal. Please open your browser and go to: https://amz-customerverify.com
Okay, I'm entering that now. Is this the regular Amazon site?
This is Amazon's secure verification portal, specifically for customs compliance. Please log in using your Amazon username and password, then follow the prompts.
Alright, I've logged in. It's asking for my phone number.
Please enter your phone number. This step ensures we can notify you of your order's updated status and any refund processed.
Done. Is there anything else I need to do?
You're almost finished. The system may prompt you to enable two-step verification. Please follow any on-screen instructions to complete verification.
It says my account is being reviewed. Should I wait here?

Yes, please remain on the page. Once the review is complete, your order will be released and your refund processed. Not completing this process could result in account lockout and further delivery delays.
I really hope this works, I need those headphones soon.
You've been very cooperative, Mr. Riley. Your swift action is ensuring no disruption to your Amazon account or orders. Is there anything else I can help you with while we wait?
